traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text:
The mastodon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception)
checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text:
If the mastodon moves at least 20 feet straight
towards a creature and then hits with a gore attack on the same turn, that
creature must succeed on a DC 19 Strength check or be knocked prone.
If the target is prone, the mastodon can make one stomp attack against it
as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27
(4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 48
(6d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 17
Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the mammoth’s
next turn.
